translations.web: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.
translations.bsb: They led Jesus away to the high priest, and all the chief priests, elders, and scribes assembled.
translations.kjv: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
